name: Jakobsweg Österreich
description_md:
Jakobsweg Oesterreich is a waymarked hiking route in Austria spanning 1419.3 km. The hard route features 30801 m of ascent and 29421 m of descent, requiring about 436 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule.

This international waymarked hiking network passes Vienna and the Battle of Vienna within 100 m. It also passes DO&CO Albertina within 300 m.
